summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust Active Factor Small Cap ETF (AFSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of US small-cap companies that exhibit exposure to one or more investing factors. AFSM was launched on Dec 3, 2019 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: AFSM is an equity ETF with a total of 335 individual holdings. The top holdings are National HealthCare stock at 0.95%, Par Pacific Holdings at 0.90%, Liquidia at 0.84%, Blue Bird at 0.83%, and Ames National at 0.80%.
